title: Add RAG agent templates, tool-calling examples, and docs quickstarts
author: Priya Patel
description: This PR adds a set of RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) agent templates, tool-calling example quickstarts for agents that integrate with the Redwood tools API, and corresponding documentation updates on the docs site. Motivation: give devs reproducible starting points for common RAG+agent patterns (faq-bot, ticket-triage, research-assistant) and show idiomatic usage of tool-calling and structured outputs. The change includes example repos under redwood-examples, updated docs pages, and small SDK helper additions in the python and typescript SDKs. Checklist: 1) Add RAG agent templates (faq-bot, triage-bot, research-assistant) with config+sample prompts; 2) Add three quickstarts demonstrating tool-calling (search, ticket-create, knowledge-store); 3) Docs site updates: quickstart page, API references, sample responses; 4) Add end-to-end tests for examples; 5) Add CI job to validate sample apps build. Rationale and scope: examples are intentionally opinionated but small; they show model selection, vector-store setup, caching hints, and rollout suggestions. This PR is focused on developer DX and contains no runtime changes to inference kernels.
